quotes.name: Strength of Arms
quotes.flavor:
"We fight not for Avacyn, but for her ideals; not for the church, but for its people."
—Thalia, Guardian of Thraben

quotes.name: Roilmage's Trick
quotes.flavor: Weather on Zendikar is unpredictable—unless you're the one telling it what to do.

quotes.name: Castle Ardenvale
quotes.flavor: The hall was long and wide and filled with shadows. Mighty pillars upheld its lofty roof.

quotes.name: Spartan Veteran
quotes.flavor: The Spartans attack relentlessly, giving their opponents no time to think or breathe.

quotes.name: Shipwreck Marsh
quotes.flavor:
"There's one survivor. There's a thing in the belly of that ship that can't ever die."
—River Song

quotes.name: Crushing Canopy
quotes.flavor:
"Do not mistake your lofty vantage point for safety."
—Shaper Tuvasa

quotes.name: Crimson Manticore
quotes.flavor: Noted neither for their good looks nor their charm, Crimson Manticores can be fearsome allies. As dinner companions, however, they are best left alone.

quotes.name: Harness Infinity
quotes.flavor:
"As I stepped into the star arch, it all became perfectly clear. Life and death are not opposites, but an endless path, twisting around and back upon itself, never ending and never beginning."
—Zhaer, professor of biophilosophy

quotes.name: Happy Hogan, Bodyguard
quotes.flavor: "Move along folks. Move along."

quotes.name: Skirk Drill Sergeant
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Elves vs. Goblins
quotes.flavor: "I order you to volunteer."

quotes.name: Reassembling Skeleton
quotes.flavor: Though you may see the same bones, you'll never see the same skeleton twice.

quotes.name: Sam's Desperate Rescue
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "By all the signs, there's a large warrior loose, with an Elf-sword, and an axe as well maybe." Gorbag spat. Sam smiled grimly at this description of himself.

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Kindly Customer
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen that girl in here quite a lot. Seems to me she has quite a little crush on you."
—Iroh, to Zuko

quotes.name: Deflecting Palm
quotes.flavor:
「歴史の学徒は誰しもが過去から学ぶ力を持つ。偉大な者たちはそれを自らの利益のために用いる。」
――ロアホールドの学部長、プラーグ

quotes.name: Goblin Chirurgeon
quotes.flavor:
"I asked one of my aides how they do it, but all he'd say was, 'Trust me, Mayor, you don't want to know.'"
—Lydia Wynforth, Mayor of Trokair

quotes.name: Springleaf Drum
quotes.flavor:
"It is neither the species of leaf nor the thickness of branch that creates music. Gaea's song is already in the drum."
—Gamelen, Citanul elder

quotes.name: Mystic of the Hidden Way
quotes.flavor: "There are no obstacles, only different paths."

quotes.name: Divination
quotes.flavor:
"The key to unlocking this puzzle is within you."
—Doriel, mentor of Mistral Isle

quotes.name: Annex
quotes.flavor: Most refugees left their ancestral homes behind when they came to Otaria. A few decided to bring them along.

quotes.name: Servant of the Conduit
quotes.flavor: "Creation without connection to nature is just manufacture."

quotes.name: Belligerent Yearling
quotes.flavor: One day it will be as terrifying as it thinks it is.

quotes.name: Diamond Mare
quotes.flavor: When it passes, rainbows follow.

quotes.name: Jubilant Skybonder
quotes.flavor: She was born unable to walk. Through the *eludha*, she was able to fly.

quotes.name: Scavenging Scarab
quotes.flavor: The beetles feed not on the flesh of corpses but on the metal, grinding out the iron and steel to add to their own bulky shells.

quotes.name: Wall of Water
quotes.flavor: A deafening roar arose as the fury of an enormous vertical river supplanted our serenity. Eddies turned into whirling geysers, leveling everything in their path.

quotes.name: Tundra Wall
quotes.flavor: Wolf Cove's snow fort doubles as Sokka's watchtower and a playground for Water Tribe children.

quotes.name: Inhumaniac
quotes.flavor: For the mind-minded mastermind.

quotes.name: Uglúk of the White Hand
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: "I am Uglúk. I command. I return to Isengard by the shortest road."

quotes.name: Alloy Golem
quotes.flavor:
"We turned old weapons into new warriors."
—Jhoira, master artificer

quotes.name: Hide in Plain Sight
quotes.flavor: The trees look beautiful... until they look back.

quotes.name: Phyrexian Altar
quotes.flavor:
"Unskin these impure bodies, Great Yawgmoth, that the flesh may welcome your blessings."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

quotes.name: Soltari Priest
quotes.flavor: "In Rath," the priest said, "there is even greater need for prayer."

quotes.name: Flaming Fist Officer
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "Get the remaining citizens to safety! These miscreants have an appointment with my spear."

quotes.name: Bounding Krasis
quotes.flavor: Unpredictable as a storm and destructive as a tidal wave.

quotes.name: Dreamdew Entrancer
quotes.flavor: "Your dreams are too precious to leave to chance."

quotes.name: Rakdos Signet
quotes.flavor: Made of bone and boiled in blood, a Rakdos signet is not considered finished until it has been used as a murder weapon.

quotes.name: Scorching Shot
quotes.flavor: Most outlaws prefer to strike when there are no witnesses. Slickshots prefer as many as possible.

quotes.name: Wurmcoil Larva
quotes.flavor: Even a scrap of Phyrexian machinery can be lethal.

quotes.name: Mana Drain
quotes.flavor: Enthusiasm is no match for preparation.

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "I've sworn to protect the people from the horrors that would destroy them—even if those horrors are the angels themselves."

quotes.name: Volcanic Wind
quotes.flavor: The Cho-Arrim call it "the fury of Ramos."

quotes.name: Satyr Wayfinder
quotes.flavor: The first satyr to wake after a revel must search for the site of the next one.

quotes.name: Dissolve
quotes.flavor: "You thought only the gods could stop you?"

quotes.name: Shadowblood Ridge
quotes.flavor: The carnage of conflicts long past still stains the Otarian soil.

quotes.name: Dunland Crebain
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor:
"What's that, Strider? It don't look like a cloud."
—Sam

quotes.name: Unnatural Predation
quotes.flavor:
"Domination by the strongest—that is all that matters in the Tangle now."
—Vorinclex, Voice of Hunger

quotes.name: Commander Liara Portyr
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor: "It's a ghoul-eat-you world out there. Follow my orders if you want to survive."

quotes.name: Narrow Escape
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition
quotes.flavor: He could find no strength left to budge, no power left to fight, no will left to live. Luckily, they could find him.

quotes.name: Boneclub Berserker
quotes.flavor: Bolstered by the cheers of his warren, Trugg was ready to make his appearance in Auntie Grub's tales.

quotes.name: Perish
quotes.flavor:
"There will come a time when the voices of soil and seedling will sing only laments."
—Oracle *en*-Vec

quotes.name: Varchild's Crusader
quotes.flavor:
"Every patch of land must belong to Kjeldor, no matter what the cost!"
—General Varchild

quotes.name: Wolfkin Outcast // Wedding Crasher
quotes.flavor: The villagers feared him. The cathars scorned him. Only in the wilds did he find a family that accepted him.

quotes.name: Magnifying Glass
quotes.flavor: Knight-Inquisitors of Saint Raban delve deep into mysteries best left unexplored.

quotes.name: Sonar Strike
quotes.flavor: Valley's midnight clerics channel the life force of other animals into blinding strikes and searing shrieks.

quotes.name: Cryptcaller Chariot
quotes.flavor:
"They too deserve to witness Amonkhet's rebirth."
—Zahur

quotes.name: Everybody Lives!
quotes.flavor:
"Everybody lives, Rose. Just this once, everybody lives!"
—The Ninth Doctor

quotes.name: Azami, Lady of Scrolls
quotes.flavor: "Fashion belongs to those with the luxuries of style and taste. I have both."

quotes.name: Phantasmal Forces
quotes.flavor: These beings embody the essence of true heroes long dead. Summoned from the dreamrealms, they rise to meet their enemies.

quotes.name: Alluring Siren
quotes.flavor: She lures victims with promises of flesh, captures them in a net of deceit, and destroys them in the embrace of the sea.

quotes.name: Riftsweeper
quotes.flavor: "Beings of the rifts are not natural. No longer will these abominations tread upon the body of Gaea."

quotes.name: Mindleech Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"This still doesn't make you the brains of the operation."
—Ghoulcaller Gisa

quotes.name: Zuran Spellcaster
quotes.flavor:
"A mage must be precise as well as potent; cautious, as well as clever."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Kira, Great Glass-Spinner
quotes.flavor: Each spell is an intricate tapestry, and Kira is the great unraveler.

quotes.name: Runechanter's Pike
quotes.flavor: As sharp as its bearer's words of faith.

quotes.name: Mistmeadow Skulk
quotes.flavor: Doyo suspected the boggarts of brewing a plot against his crop, so he scythed away his grain to clear the sightlines.

quotes.name: Havenwood Wurm
quotes.flavor: Time rifts bring tunneling beasts of old into the hard, dry earth of the present. Most die there, trapped, but the mightiest burst through the surface.

quotes.name: Tidepool Turtle
quotes.flavor: Prized by wizards as a mobile scrying pool, it bears visions drawn from the depths of the sea.

quotes.name: Spellbreaker Behemoth
quotes.flavor:
"Some think its immunity to countermagic evolved because of the constant mage attacks on Naya. I think it just ate a bunch of wizards."
—Broka, drumhunter

quotes.name: Lava Serpent
quotes.flavor: Lavabrink's boiling moat is a deterrent for most, and a relaxing bath for one.

quotes.name: Siren Stormtamer
quotes.flavor: He's the calm that hides the coming storm.

quotes.name: Pinnacle Monk // Mystic Peak
quotes.flavor: Narset brought the Jeskai djinn ancient wisdom and the promise to challenge the status quo.

quotes.name: Aura Extraction
quotes.flavor: Every day, Order clerics contain as much of the Mirari's energy as possible, hoping to delay Otaria's demise.

quotes.name: Swords to Plowshares
quotes.flavor:
"So that's what it means to be a Doctor of War."
—The First Doctor

quotes.name: Leopard-Spotted Jiao
quotes.flavor: This strange beast has the hide of a leopard, the howl of a dog, and the horns of an ox.

quotes.name: Battle-Rattle Shaman
quotes.flavor: The shaman rattles not to inspire a battle fury but to drown out the shrieks of those fleeing the Eldrazi.

quotes.name: Flame Rift
quotes.flavor: Crovax hungered for power, and the stronghold devoured the sky.

quotes.name: Bile Blight
quotes.flavor: Not an arrow loosed, javelin thrown, nor sword raised. None were needed.

quotes.name: Grenzo, Havoc Raiser
quotes.flavor: "You burn. I'll pillage."

quotes.name: Mahamoti Djinn
quotes.flavor: Of royal blood among the spirits of the air, the Mahamoti djinn rides on the wings of the winds. As dangerous in the gambling hall as he is in battle, he is a master of trickery and misdirection.

quotes.name: Kiora of Salt and Sand
quotes.flavor: "The sea ends where I say it does."

quotes.name: Beast Whisperer
quotes.flavor: "Despite its ghastly appearance, the Ravnican murder budgie makes quite an erudite conversationalist."

quotes.name: Gigantosaurus
quotes.flavor:
"Each tooth is the length of a horse, and new ones grow in every sixteen days. Let's get a closer look!"
—Vivien Reid

quotes.name: Brindle Shoat
quotes.flavor: Hunters lure the stripling boar into the open, hoping to trap greater prey.

quotes.name: Lindblum, Industrial Regency // Mage Siege
quotes.flavor: A city encircled by the ramparts of a massive castle.

quotes.name: Shimmering Grotto
quotes.flavor:
"This is the price of being last in the food chain. We must keep our places of beauty hidden away instead of displayed for all to see."
—Hildin, priest of Avacyn

quotes.name: Bubbling Muck
quotes.flavor: The muck claims a hundred living things for each meager treasure it spews forth.

quotes.name: Curse of Stalked Prey
quotes.flavor:
"Innocent thorns can fill the air with your bloodscent. Don't stray from the path."
—Elmut, crossway watcher

quotes.name: Angel of Despair
quotes.flavor:
"I feel in them a sense of duty and commitment, yet I can feel nothing else. It is as if their duty is to an empty void."
—Razia

quotes.name: Reliquary Tower
quotes.flavor: Once guarded by the Knights of the Reliquary, the tower stands now protected only by its own remoteness, its dusty treasures open to plunder by anyone.

quotes.name: Simic Signet
quotes.flavor: For the Simic Combine, its sigil serves not as an emblem of honor but as a trademark. Its familiar image on any biological commodity attests to superb craftsmanship, ingenious innovation, and higher cost.

quotes.name: Enchantress's Presence
quotes.flavor: "The wise learn from successes as well as mistakes."

quotes.name: Spiteful Prankster
quotes.flavor: The devil appreciated the irony of using doves for ammunition. The townsfolk, not so much.

quotes.name: Befoul
quotes.flavor:
"The land putrefied at its touch, turned into an oily bile in seconds."
—Radiant, archangel

quotes.name: Spider-Sense
quotes.flavor: "My spider-sense—it's tingling! Something behind me!"

quotes.name: Opulent Palace
quotes.flavor:
"Gather now, faithful followers of the most wise and beneficent Mothman. Let us light his holy beacon with the radiance of the fireflies."
—Brother Moncrief

quotes.name: Fellwar Stone
quotes.flavor:
"What do you have that I cannot obtain?"
—Mairsil, the Pretender

quotes.name: Brainstorm
quotes.flavor: "My Spider-Sense again. It's never tingled like this before."

quotes.name: Heat Ray
quotes.flavor:
"There was clearly a scream. I'm not sure if there was a mouth."
—Sachir, Akoum Expeditionary House

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor: Somewhere in Time *(1986)*

quotes.name: Scion of the Swarm
quotes.flavor: Vampires are now masters of their own fates, commanders of their own legions.

quotes.name: Dimir Doppelganger
quotes.flavor: "Fear not. Your life will not go unlived."

quotes.name: Rootbound Crag
quotes.flavor:
"All we have to do is open the doors and read the very first words in recorded history..."
—The Eleventh Doctor

quotes.name: Baloth Woodcrasher
quotes.flavor: Its insatiable hunger quickly depletes a region of prey. It must migrate from place to place to feed its massive bulk.

quotes.name: Sacred Wolf
quotes.flavor:
"I raised my bow, and the wolf stared at me. Under its gaze, my finger would not release the string."
—Aref the Hunter

quotes.name: Planetarium of Wan Shi Tong
quotes.flavor: It charts the movements of heavenly bodies, forecasting the fates of nations.

quotes.name: Demon's Horn
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Divine vs. Demonic
quotes.flavor: Its curve mimics the twists of life and death.

quotes.name: Prey Upon
quotes.flavor: It is the nature of the strong to survive.

quotes.name: Vial of Dragonfire
quotes.flavor: Designed by an ancient artificer, the vials are strong enough to hold the very breath of a dragon—until it's needed.

quotes.name: Unbury
quotes.flavor: A well-aged boggart body is steeped in magics richer than any fae glamer.

quotes.name: Cryptic Caves
quotes.flavor: Only when you've given up the search will the caves yield their secrets.

quotes.name: Leaden Myr
quotes.flavor: The myr are like necrogen: a transformative force unconcerned with the changes they wreak.

quotes.name: Medusa, Inhuman Queen
quotes.flavor: "I speak for Black Bolt. We will not stand for those who would threaten our Terrigen and the safety of our people."

quotes.name: Knighthood
quotes.flavor:
"He has returned. He who brought the dark ones. He who poisoned our paradise. How shall we greet him? With swift and certain death!"
—Radiant, archangel

quotes.name: Marvin, Murderous Mimic
quotes.flavor: In a moment of bloodthirsty whimsy, a razorkin once picked up a ventriloquist's puppet and used it to terrorize a survivor. Now it hunts on its own, with no one pulling its strings.

quotes.name: Narstad Scrapper
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, the principles of corpse animation applied to bloodless materials!"
—Ludevic, necro-alchemist

quotes.name: Skirk Prospector
quotes.flavor: Deep beneath the ruined continent of Otaria, there's a mine where goblins still work, ignorant of the destruction above.

quotes.name: Challenger Troll
quotes.flavor: For most, war is a calamity. For some, an opportunity. And for the very few, a pleasure.

quotes.name: Urbis Protector
quotes.flavor:
"Guilds be damned. We can fend for ourselves."
—Vennick of the Gateless

quotes.name: Earth Elemental
quotes.flavor: Earth elementals have the eternal strength of stone and the endurance of mountains. Primordially connected to the land they inhabit, they take a long-term view of things, scorning the impetuous haste of short-lived mortal creatures.

quotes.name: Insist
quotes.flavor:
"Finesse is no match for brute force."
—Seton, centaur druid

quotes.name: Marauding Knight
quotes.flavor: "They ride our trails as if they were designed to," said the guard. "They were," replied Gerrard.

quotes.name: Wind Drake
quotes.flavor: Air currents whip through the city corridors, creating wind tunnels that accelerate urban drakes toward their prey.

quotes.name: Cathartic Reunion
quotes.flavor: The chasm of years and worlds collapsed under the power of their embrace.

quotes.name: Phantasmal Dragon
quotes.flavor: Its hunger and ire are no less for being wrought of lies and mist.

quotes.name: Buried Alive
quotes.flavor:
"I'm getting better."
"No you're not. You'll be stone dead in a moment."

quotes.name: Nature's Lore
quotes.flavor:
"Every seed planted is another lesson the forest can teach us."
—Arathel, elvish queen

quotes.name: Curtain of Light
quotes.flavor:
"Paint gold upon the wind, Shape the wind into a shield, And vanish behind the brightness."
—Snow-Fur, kitsune poet

quotes.name: Archaeomancer
quotes.flavor: "Words of power never disappear. They sleep, awaiting those with the will to rouse them."

quotes.name: Mudbutton Torchrunner
quotes.flavor: The oil sloshes against his skull as he nears his destination: the Frogtosser Games and the lighting of the Flaming Boggart.

quotes.name: Staff of the Wild Magus
quotes.flavor: A symbol of ferocity in oppressive times.

quotes.name: Pair o' Dice Lost
quotes.flavor: The Astrotorium is a zero-waste facility, meaning it deals with zero of its waste.

quotes.name: Ardent Militia
quotes.flavor: Knights fight for honor and mercenaries fight for gold. The militia fights for hearth and home.

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Briar Shield
quotes.flavor: In all its forms, the forest is the elves' best protector.

quotes.name: Stoic Ephemera
quotes.flavor: "Life is fleeting, and so is death. Only the oath is eternal."

quotes.name: Esper Sentinel
quotes.flavor: The more Esper changes, the more he refuses to.

quotes.name: Nantuko Disciple
quotes.flavor:
Unanswered prayers are themselves answers.
—Nantuko teaching

quotes.name: Vitu-Ghazi, the City-Tree
quotes.flavor: In the autumn, she casts her seeds across the streets below, and come spring, her children rise in service to the Conclave.

quotes.name: Aphetto Runecaster
quotes.flavor: "The ignorant fear change; the wise use it as a weapon."

quotes.name: Cultivate
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: All seeds share a common bond, calling to each other across infinity.

quotes.name: Sun Titan
quotes.flavor: A blazing sun that never sets.

quotes.name: Burning Sun Cavalry
quotes.flavor: "By fire and lightning, tooth and claw, we will send these invaders fleeing back to Torrezon!"

quotes.name: Into the Night
quotes.flavor:
"When lost souls wander into the woods, the wilds have a way of showing them who they really are."
—Rahilda, Vildin-Pack alpha

quotes.name: Conifer Strider
quotes.flavor: Atarka's presence thaws the glaciers of Qal Sisma, forcing its elementals to migrate or adapt.

quotes.name: Heliod, the Radiant Dawn // Heliod, the Warped Eclipse
quotes.flavor:
"*Compleat* the god, *compleat* the plane."
—Ajani Goldmane

quotes.name: Ragefire
quotes.flavor: "Your precious laws can't save you now!"

quotes.name: Spikeshot Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"Proximity discouraged. Do not approach."
—Vulshok field guide

quotes.name: Swarm of Rats
quotes.flavor:
"Rats, rats, rats! Hundreds, thousands, millions of them, and every one a life."
—Bram Stoker, *Dracula*

quotes.name: Barrow Ghoul
quotes.flavor:
"They killed my family to deny me a future. They fed on my ancestors to deny me a past."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Knight of Malice
quotes.flavor: A shadow to swallow the light.

quotes.name: Thalia, Guardian of Thraben
quotes.flavor: "Thraben is our home and I will not see it fall to this unhallowed horde."

quotes.name: Char-Rumbler
quotes.flavor: Elementals flourished as Dominaria healed and new forms of life adapted to the land's reinfusion with mana.

quotes.name: Court of Grace
quotes.set_name: Phyrexia: All Will Be One Commander
quotes.flavor: A righteous sovereign makes for a blessed realm.

quotes.name: Sky Crier
quotes.flavor: "Breaking news! Lord Xander found dead! Suspect at large!"

quotes.name: Woodland Cemetery
quotes.flavor: There are more dead here than the gravestones suggest.

quotes.name: Leave in the Dust
quotes.flavor: The daredevil racers of the Derby Crows, long at odds with the Consulate, were quick to join the renegades in open revolt.

quotes.name: Craterhoof Behemoth
quotes.flavor: Its footsteps of today are the lakes of tomorrow.

quotes.name: Winged Shepherd
quotes.flavor:
"When the Hour of Promise arrives, the God-Pharaoh will tear down the Hekma, for its protection will be needed no longer."
—*The Accounting of Hours*

quotes.name: Tendrils of Corruption
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Garruk vs. Liliana
quotes.flavor: Darkness doesn't always send its minions to do its dirty work.

quotes.name: Arcum Dagsson
quotes.flavor: "Artifice sundered the world. It shall not again wreak such sorrow."

quotes.name: Reckless Embermage
quotes.flavor: Many mages have been consumed by their work.

quotes.name: Strength-Testing Hammer
quotes.flavor: "I don't know you, but that hammer rings a bell."

quotes.name: Merfolk Mesmerist
quotes.flavor: www.MagicTheGathering.com

quotes.name: Elite Archers
quotes.flavor: They fletch their arrows with the feathers of angels.

quotes.name: Panoptic Projektor
quotes.flavor: It displays every fact, every suspect, and every scrap of evidence for every case the Agency oversees.

quotes.name: Disfigure
quotes.flavor: "Brave scar or unfortunate tale? It all depends on your pain threshold."

quotes.name: Aeronaut Admiral
quotes.flavor: The Consulate recruits its best pilots from the League of Aeronauts. Many go on to command entire fleets.

quotes.name: Hunting Velociraptor
quotes.flavor:
"Clever girl."
—Robert Muldoon

quotes.name: Vision of Love
quotes.flavor: Love transcends all barriers.

quotes.name: Worlds Within Worlds
quotes.flavor:
"Uh, I think I might have overdone it a smidge."
—Ant-Man, Scott Lang

quotes.name: Adaptive Gemguard
quotes.flavor: Left to their own devices, gnomes reengineer their own devices.

quotes.name: Covetous Dragon
quotes.flavor: Gatha survived as long as he did by giving all Keld's predators exactly what they wanted.

quotes.name: Serene Heart
quotes.flavor:
"If magic is your crutch, cast it aside and learn to walk without it."
—Teferi

quotes.name: Tendrils of Agony
quotes.flavor:
"Awwww, did we bweak da iddy-biddy spider?"
—Venom

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor:
"After we lost the war, we got peace, but with that, we lost something else. Now look at Wutai..."
—Yuffie Kisaragi

quotes.name: Talisman of Curiosity
quotes.flavor:
"The pain of exploring is less than the pain of not knowing."
—Tamiyo

quotes.name: Serra Angel
quotes.flavor: Born with wings of light and a sword of faith, this heavenly incarnation embodies both fury and purity.

quotes.name: Ravages of War
quotes.flavor:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, *Tao Te Ching* (trans. Feng and English)

quotes.name: Liu Bei, Lord of Shu
quotes.flavor:
"Only wisdom and virtue can truly win men's devotion."
—Liu Bei

quotes.name: Deathmark Prelate
quotes.flavor: Death is a secret he is willing to share.

quotes.name: Goblin Pyromancer
quotes.flavor: "The good news is, we figured out how the wand works. The bad news is, we figured out how the wand works."

quotes.name: Rummaging Goblin
quotes.flavor: To a goblin, value is based on the four S's: shiny, stabby, smelly, and super smelly.

quotes.name: Tower of Eons
quotes.flavor: Its etchings tell the ur-golems' stories of an entity able to force life into a lifeless plane.

quotes.name: Quicksilver Amulet
quotes.flavor:
"If powerstones are energy stored in material form, could we store matter as energy in the same way?"
—Rayne, research notes

quotes.name: Geometer's Arthropod
quotes.flavor:
"Creatures that have survived blood-soaked millennia should not be underestimated."
—Nev, dean of substance

quotes.name: Command Beacon
quotes.flavor:
"I gazed once into that light. Now it burns in my mind, forever denying me rest."
—Riku of Two Reflections

quotes.name: Fog Elemental
quotes.flavor:
"I've seen fog so thick you could cut it, but none that could cut me."
—Tahngarth of the *Weatherlight*

quotes.name: Laboratory Maniac
quotes.flavor: His mind whirled with grand plans, never thinking of what might happen if he were to succeed.

quotes.name: Gratuitous Violence
quotes.flavor: Only the Cabal could make a fight to the death more deadly.

quotes.name: Strategic Planning
quotes.flavor:
"Bolas remade this place in his image. He has the advantage here. We must approach carefully."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Basal Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Fascinating . . . These creatures display the paradox of tenacity and purposed self-destruction I have sought to breed into my thrulls."
—Endrek Sahr, master breeder

quotes.name: Corpsejack Menace
quotes.flavor: "Fear. Feed. Stronger. Spread my spawn."

quotes.name: Deep Analysis
quotes.flavor: "The specimen seems to be broken."

quotes.name: Slaughter Singer
quotes.flavor: After giving in to the thrill of the hunt, he could never again return to the quiet of the Basilica.

quotes.name: Wall of Runes
quotes.flavor:
"It's strangely satisfying seeing an undead killing machine from another world standing befuddled in front of a wall of text."
—Lavinia

quotes.name: Fodder Tosser
quotes.flavor:
"In event of siege, load copiously with: hot oil, cannonballs, caltrops, rubble, old swords, mess-hall leftovers, chamber pots, broken chairs, salt, cousin Furt . . ."
—Trebuchet instructions

quotes.name: Opportunist
quotes.flavor: The third time the Oracle glanced suspiciously at him, Starke decided she had glanced twice too often.

quotes.name: Fire-Lit Thicket
quotes.flavor: Occupancy of the den changes from night to night as boggart gangs fight for control of a place they aren't willing to simply eat.

quotes.name: Ill-Gotten Gains
quotes.flavor: Urza thought it a crusade. Xantcha knew it was a robbery.

quotes.name: Southern Elephant
quotes.flavor: While defending their southern borders, both the Wu and Shu kingdoms fought against the barbarians' trained elephants.

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: In the skies of the Si Wong Desert, a solitary winged lemur searched in vain for a lost friend.

quotes.name: Wayfarer's Bauble
quotes.flavor: It is the forest beyond the horizon, the mountain waiting to be climbed, the new land across the endless sea.

quotes.name: Azorius Guildgate
quotes.flavor: The Azorius symbol stares down like a great eye, reminding visitors of the watchful presence of Isperia and her lawmages.

quotes.name: Goblin Haberdasher
quotes.flavor: An accessory in every sense of the word.

quotes.name: Remnant Elemental
quotes.flavor: Even until Exodus Day, those in power on Kavaron refused to acknowledge that the planet was trying to tell them something.

quotes.name: Grim Affliction
quotes.flavor: Even the small wounds let hope bleed out.

quotes.name: Cloudshift
quotes.flavor:
"Even storm clouds bow to worship Avacyn."
—Elder Rimheit

quotes.name: Peace of Mind
quotes.flavor:
"What can a peasant get for free that an emperor can never buy?"
—Dal riddle

quotes.name: Serum Visionary
quotes.flavor: "Pre-criminal notions detected in the Sixth Precinct. The suspect will confess when arrested in two hours."

quotes.name: Consider
quotes.flavor: Ivold gasped in surprise. Either a very strange insect had crawled onto one of the lenses or he was seeing geists at last!

quotes.name: Fireslinger
quotes.flavor:
"Remember the moral of the fireslinger fable: with power comes isolation."
—Karn, silver golem

quotes.name: Glistener Elf
quotes.flavor: |svu,nLeDC,pnDFtLseen TusWotL,vfyrswne%m DUwbT,bVOceP.

quotes.name: Patchwork Beastie
quotes.flavor: It doesn't know it isn't real.

quotes.name: Warhorn Blast
quotes.flavor: "Mead down! Swords up!"

quotes.name: Windborn Muse
quotes.flavor:
"Her voice is justice, clear and relentless."
—Akroma, angelic avenger

quotes.name: Extract Brain
quotes.flavor: No thought is as succulent as a secret.

quotes.name: Reckless Racer
quotes.flavor: Illegal street races turned out to be perfect practice for avoiding Consulate patrols.

quotes.name: Quasiduplicate
quotes.flavor: "My greatest creation—me!"

quotes.name: Bake into a Pie
quotes.flavor: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

quotes.name: Pyrotechnics
quotes.flavor:
"Who says lightning never strikes twice?"
—Storm shaman

quotes.name: Screeching Griffin
quotes.flavor: They were master fishers, but their seas are now the streets and their catch, the goblins that run pell-mell from the screeching in the sky.

quotes.name: Viridian Betrayers
quotes.flavor: To secure a place in Phyrexia's ranks, they hunted their surviving kin.

quotes.name: Idyllic Grange
quotes.flavor: Every hero's journey starts somewhere.

quotes.name: Skyshroud Claim
quotes.flavor: The forest's constant struggle is to keep the spreading flowstone at bay.

quotes.name: Looter il-Kor
quotes.flavor: Unable to touch items of value, he goes forth to steal secrets instead.

quotes.name: Abigale, Eloquent First-Year
quotes.flavor: The right poem lifts more than spirits.

quotes.name: Doom Blade
quotes.flavor: The void is without substance but cuts like steel.

quotes.name: Promise of Loyalty
quotes.flavor: "It's us against the world. Forever."

quotes.name: Chosen by Heliod
quotes.flavor:
"Training and studies aid a soldier in meager amounts. The gods do the rest."
—Brigone, soldier of Meletis

quotes.name: Errant Doomsayers
quotes.flavor: "Heed my words, traveler. Plagues, war, desolation . . . all mere hints of what is yet to come from Dominaria's vault of horrors."

quotes.name: Staunch-Hearted Warrior
quotes.flavor: As soon as she faces a monster, she begins composing its epitaph.

quotes.name: Saw in Half
quotes.flavor: The audience always loves it, but volunteers are divided.

quotes.name: Somberwald Vigilante
quotes.flavor: He has nothing left but his resentment.

quotes.name: Comforting Counsel
quotes.flavor: In the grief that followed the Invasion, Willowdusk's office turned into an unofficial hideaway for overwhelmed students.

quotes.name: East Wind Avatar
quotes.flavor: Azrael was born on the wind to guide others to new beginnings.

quotes.name: Hill Giant
quotes.flavor: Fortunately, Hill Giants have large blind spots in which a human can easily hide. Unfortunately, these blind spots are beneath the bottoms of their feet.

quotes.name: Almost Perfect
quotes.flavor: An incomplete suit of power armor is still a suit of power armor.

quotes.name: Graven Lore
quotes.flavor: The runes glow beneath the snow, bearing memories of a time when the old gods ruled the realms.

quotes.name: Ghitu Journeymage
quotes.flavor: The Ghitu of Shiv are as fierce and uncompromising as their volcanic home.

quotes.name: Clamor Shaman
quotes.flavor:
"Little goblin. Big noise."
—Ruric Thar

quotes.name: Nefashu
quotes.flavor: Where the nefashu pass, blood rolls like a silk carpet.

quotes.name: Lotus Petal
quotes.flavor: "Hard to imagine," mused Hanna, stroking the petal, "such a lovely flower inspiring such greed."

quotes.name: Venom
quotes.flavor:
"I told him it was just a flesh wound, but the next time I looked at him, poor Tadhg was dead and gone."
—Maeveen O'Donagh, *Memoirs of a Soldier*

quotes.name: Leyline of the Void
quotes.flavor: Cracks in the facade of the House lead not to escape but to oblivion.

quotes.name: Cobbled Lancer
quotes.flavor:
"Don't worry everyone—I hear hoofbeats! The Gavony Riders are coming to save us!"
—Adin, Moorland villager

quotes.name: Command Tower
quotes.flavor: Safe havens amid the desert and dragonstorms, Abzan fortresses attract merchants, travelers, outcasts, and exiles.

quotes.name: Jorn, God of Winter // Kaldring, the Rimestaff
quotes.flavor: "Wherever snow falls, I am home."

quotes.name: Lose Calm
quotes.flavor: A lifetime of discipline forsaken in a moment of rage.

quotes.name: Bala Ged Recovery // Bala Ged Sanctuary
quotes.flavor:
"I know it's around here somewhere."
—Doral, Bala Ged guide

quotes.name: Karametra's Favor
quotes.flavor: The harvest god's cornucopia contains the fruits of the fields, the forest, and beyond.

quotes.name: Know Naught but Fire
quotes.flavor: "Cranial explosions for everyone. Still planning to outthink my dragons?"

quotes.name: Cenn's Tactician
quotes.flavor: "A well-trained force brings peace . . . which brings more time for training!"

quotes.name: Fling
quotes.flavor: Masters of the sword know the blade is not the only weapon at their disposal.

quotes.name: Boros Reckoner
quotes.flavor:
"Imagine a thunderstorm that's also a tactical genius. That's him."
—Dars Gostok, Firefist captain

quotes.name: Tidespout Tyrant
quotes.flavor: He unmakes the world in his own image.

quotes.name: Noble Hierarch
quotes.flavor: She protects the sacred groves from blight, drought, and the Unbeholden.

quotes.name: Steel-Plume Marshal
quotes.flavor: The defenders watched in terror as the flying V split apart into a bristling battle formation.

quotes.name: Grenzo's Cutthroat
quotes.flavor: "Their guards are soft, ready to welcome a sharp dagger."

quotes.name: Novice Occultist
quotes.flavor: All across Gavony, in shuttered bedrooms and locked barns, young people seek the answers their elders failed to provide.

quotes.name: Millstone
quotes.flavor: Minds, like mountains, are never so grand and mighty that they can't be reduced to dust.

quotes.name: Dark Fortress
quotes.flavor:
"You talk of freedoms. Liberty. Whose hands do you think built these battlements? In their hearts, peasants want to be ruled."
—Baron Zemo

quotes.name: Worthy Knight
quotes.flavor: Every Ardenvale aspirant must step through the flame. Their honor determines whether they burn or shine.

quotes.name: Magma Sliver
quotes.flavor: As malleable as molten steel, but as dangerous as the finished blade.

quotes.name: Gloomlake Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Floodpits languish like a corpse, the clear waters choked by the filthy hands of the bog.

quotes.name: Sword of the Chosen
quotes.flavor: One shard of Selenia yet remained.

quotes.name: Prize Wall
quotes.flavor:
"That bear's been there since the Astrotorium opened. I've seen it move."
—Ernst, deep fry cook

quotes.name: Primal Huntbeast
quotes.flavor:
"To the unskilled, it appears as blurred patches of distorted light. Few have seen its true form."
—Garruk Wildspeaker

quotes.name: Ironroot Treefolk
quotes.flavor: The mating habits of Treefolk, particularly the stalwart Ironroot Treefolk, are truly absurd. Molasses comes to mind. It's amazing the species can survive at all given such protracted periods of mate selection, conjugation, and gestation.

quotes.name: Purple Worm
quotes.flavor: Underground civilizations maintain magical barriers around their settlements to deter these monsters.

quotes.name: Pirated Copy
quotes.flavor_name: Slash, Evil Turtle from Dimension X
quotes.flavor: "Gone. Paradise lost. Kill to regain."

quotes.name: Exotic Orchard
quotes.flavor:
"It was a strange morning. When we awoke, we found our trees transformed. We didn't know whether to water them or polish them."
—Pulan, Bant orchardist

quotes.name: Gerrard's Verdict
quotes.flavor: A heart of light and a soul of darkness cannot coexist.

quotes.name: Spirit Bonds
quotes.flavor: Designed by Justin Gary

quotes.name: The Master, Gallifrey's End
quotes.flavor: "A perfect army, right? Right? Oh, come in, my pretties!"

quotes.name: Metropolis Reformer
quotes.flavor: With their ancient enemy vanquished, the angels of New Capenna turned their eyes to their former captors: demons.

quotes.name: Furycalm Snarl
quotes.flavor:
"Time to find out if the heads keep growing back if you burn them with fire."
—Nick Fury, director of S.H.I.E.L.D.

quotes.name: Conspiracy Unraveler
quotes.flavor: INVARIABLY REACHES THE CORRECT CONCLUSION. CANNOT BE RUSHED.

quotes.name: Bamboo Grove Archer
quotes.flavor: "Do not mistake tranquility for domestication. This land is wild, and will always remain so."

quotes.name: Guttersnipe
quotes.flavor: He wants to watch Ravnica burn, one soul at a time.

quotes.name: Mind Control
quotes.flavor:
"The mind: a great weapon and an even greater weakness."
—Jace Beleren

quotes.name: Temple of Silence
quotes.flavor:
"We are a family of dreamers, a band of astral explorers, and a church of the mind."
—Jackson

quotes.name: Ghostly Prison
quotes.flavor: "That's the third time! And it wasn't funny the first two times either, Jim."

quotes.name: Think Twice
quotes.flavor:
"Great books are meant to be read, then read again backwards or upside down!"
—Ettovard, Tolarian archivist

quotes.name: Kris Mage
quotes.flavor: Her blade draws blood without ever touching its target.

quotes.name: Expanded Anatomy
quotes.flavor: "Changing the equation from incremental to exponential was a stroke of genius on my part."

quotes.name: Bake into a Pie
quotes.flavor: "My secret ingredient? Well, I can't tell you that. But here's a hint. It's not love."

quotes.name: Escape to the Wilds
quotes.flavor: The guards kindled the hearth and locked the door to Ellwen's chamber. By morning, the fire was out and Ellwen was gone.

quotes.name: Disdainful Stroke
quotes.flavor: In retrospect, using storm magic against a storm giant was not the wisest strategy.

quotes.name: Shadowheart, Dark Justiciar
quotes.flavor: "The shadows will not consume me-I am shielded by Lady Shar."

quotes.name: Fact or Fiction
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor: "Try to pretend like you understand what's important."

quotes.name: Bishop of Rebirth
quotes.flavor: "In the death of the foe lies the resurrection of the faithful."

quotes.name: Dark Ritual
quotes.flavor:
"Praise Nurgle! For the plague to have progressed so quickly, truly his blessing must be upon us!"
—Ku'gath Plaguefather

quotes.name: Phyrexian Rager
quotes.flavor:
"I believe many worlds will bow to Phyrexia. Mirrodin is merely the first."
—Sheoldred, Whispering One

quotes.name: Deadly Riposte
quotes.flavor:
"Automatons are fast, precise, and tireless, but they all share one weakness: predictability. Learn their patterns. Strike when they're vulnerable."
—Horance, Urzan general

quotes.name: Qasali Slingers
quotes.flavor: All things will crumble, whether by time or by force.

quotes.name: Gather the Townsfolk
quotes.flavor: In the town's final stand, they overcame the snarling beasts as well as months of insidious distrust.

quotes.name: Reflex Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"This sliver comes into the world a perfect predator. It's ready to hunt and devour its first meal within seconds of hatching."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Jalum Tome
quotes.flavor: This timeworn relic was responsible for many of Urza's victories, though he never fully comprehended its mystic runes.

quotes.name: Kid Loki
quotes.flavor: "A lie is nothing but a story. We can choose to tell a different one."

quotes.name: Despark
quotes.flavor: "The rains have ceased, and we have been graced with another beautiful day. But you are not here to see it."

quotes.name: Dizzying Gaze
quotes.flavor:
"When I cut down my angel I only started my fall."
—Crovax

quotes.name: Elsewhere Flask
quotes.flavor: One night Oona bottled the sky. The next night she aligned the stars and released it.

quotes.name: Blessed Reversal
quotes.flavor:
"A battle's outcome is never certain."
—The Southern Paladin

quotes.name: Jin-Gitaxias, Core Augur
quotes.flavor: His knowledge of the Multiverse enabled New Phyrexia to strike each plane with surgical precision.

quotes.name: Nekrataal
quotes.flavor:
"I have seen the horrors Kaervek has freed. My Betrayal is certain—but of Kaervek or of Jamuraa, I cannot say."
—Jolrael

quotes.name: Jungle Shrine
quotes.flavor: Once, the "Houses of Tomorrow." Now, the tombs of today.

quotes.name: Noxious Dragon
quotes.flavor: Dragons of Silumgar's brood begin to digest their prey even before consuming it, letting their caustic breath do much of the work.

quotes.name: Garruk Wildspeaker // Garruk Wildspeaker
quotes.flavor: Designated Hitter

quotes.name: Blessing of Frost
quotes.flavor: A friend of Jorn is never cold.

quotes.name: Dan Lewis
quotes.flavor: "What's your plan? Some clever sciencey-spacey thing I won't understand?"

quotes.name: Vampiric Fury
quotes.flavor: Many peasants secretly admire vampires' glamour and elegance—until they witness a moment of pure bloodlust.

quotes.name: Raging Goblin
quotes.flavor: He raged at the world, at his family, at his life. But mostly he just raged.

quotes.name: Ludevic, Necro-Alchemist
quotes.flavor: "How does one become a self-taught genius? Naturally, it requires brains."

quotes.name: Angelic Wall
quotes.flavor:
"The Ancestor protects us in ways we can't begin to comprehend."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Highland Forest
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"Tread carefully! The last time I walked this path, half the snowdrifts were, in fact, sleeping trolls. I've never run so fast in my life!"
—Iskene, Kannah storyteller

quotes.name: Dinosaur Stampede
quotes.flavor: If you're in the way of a ceratops charge and you're made of mere flesh and bone, then you're not really in the way.

quotes.name: Daring Leap
quotes.flavor: Most warriors think in only two dimensions. Agnate and his metathran brethren were trained to battle in three.

quotes.name: Urza's Chalice
quotes.flavor: When sorely wounded or tired, Urza would often retreat to the workshops of his apprentices. They were greatly amazed at how much better he looked each time he took a sip of water.

quotes.name: Cathar Commando
quotes.flavor: "Honorable tactics are for honorable foes. These werewolves are preying on innocent travelers. I'll stab them in the back while they sleep if I have to."

quotes.name: Winged Portent
quotes.flavor:
"No, no, it's just a murder of crows, not an omen of murder . . . I think."
—York, Kessig tracker

quotes.name: Heartfire
quotes.flavor: The mage looked within and realized there was still one piece of fuel to burn.

quotes.name: Pull from Tomorrow
quotes.flavor:
"I do things in my own time."
—Etha, initiate of Rhet crop

quotes.name: Temporal Trespass
quotes.flavor: Few truly live in the moment.

quotes.name: "Rumors of My Death . . ."
quotes.flavor: By the fourth funeral, the mooks had gotten pretty good at them.

quotes.name: HYDRA Infiltration
quotes.flavor: "HYDRA has spread its tentacles throughout all levels of society. The only question is, where will we strike next?"

quotes.name: Overgrown Farmland
quotes.flavor: A few weed-choked gourd patches are all that remain of the proud, thriving farms that once blanketed the province.

quotes.name: Reflecting Pool
quotes.flavor: Gale stared into the pool and saw a stranger. The similarities were uncanny, but it was not him.

quotes.name: Overwhelming Forces
quotes.flavor: Town Takeover! Sterling Company Expands Territory Again

quotes.name: Carnivorous Moss-Beast
quotes.flavor: Ranger wisdom dictates that when fleeing from a moss-beast, you must stay calm, find your bearings, and run south.

quotes.name: Izzet Signet
quotes.flavor: The Izzet signet is redesigned often, each time becoming closer to a vanity portrait of Niv-Mizzet.

quotes.name: Blazemire Verge
quotes.flavor: Here, the Balemurk spits and boils, the oppressive darkness pierced by scorching spears of fire.

quotes.name: The Unknown Wizard
quotes.flavor: Prize Card for the Unknown events at MagicCon Las Vegas, October 25-27, 2024

quotes.name: Erode
quotes.flavor:
"Our lives are built upon our pasts. What happens, then, if we are cut off from them?"
—Augusta, dean of order

quotes.name: Biblioplex Assistant
quotes.flavor:
"I appreciate the help, and honestly, it's very entertaining."
—Isabough of the Biblioplex

quotes.name: Windgrace's Judgment
quotes.flavor: Not all who remember Urza do so with fondness.

quotes.name: Decorated Griffin
quotes.flavor: The awards and medals of polis-dwellers mean nothing to griffins, but they repay acts of generosity.

quotes.name: Cyber Conversion
quotes.flavor: "Do not fear. We will take your fear from you. You will be like us."

quotes.name: Lavaspur Boots
quotes.flavor: These boots were made for far more than walking.

quotes.name: Spell Pierce
quotes.flavor:
"One does not need to be stronger than their opponent. You need only force them to play their hand before you've shown your own."
—*Forces of Negation: A Study in Countermagic*

quotes.name: Goblin Bombardment
quotes.flavor: One mogg to aim the catapult, one mogg to steer the rock.

quotes.name: Arcane Signet
quotes.flavor: Avishkar's power comes from its joyful innovation, in the marvels that people can build when they work together for the common good.

quotes.name: Gaea's Cradle
quotes.flavor: 2014 Legacy Championship Winner

quotes.name: Tireless Missionaries
quotes.flavor: If they succeed in their holy work, their order will vanish into welcome obscurity, for there will be no more souls to redeem.

quotes.name: Razzle-Dazzler
quotes.flavor: "Now you see me, now you—"

quotes.name: Gifted Aetherborn
quotes.flavor: A few aetherborn have discovered a way to sustain their own existences at the cost of an insatiable hunger for the life essence of other beings.

quotes.name: Dismember
quotes.flavor:
"Strip away pain, struggle, impurity, fear, flesh. Surrender the pieces and be blessed as one."
—*Phyrexian Scriptures*

quotes.name: Vampire Spawn
quotes.flavor: Unsuccessful vampire hunters often wind up as ravenous spawn.

quotes.name: Reanimate
quotes.flavor:
"You will learn to earn death."
—Volrath

quotes.name: Smoldering Butcher
quotes.flavor: A cinder's axe bears no marks from parrying a foe's blade.

quotes.name: Rampaging Cyclops
quotes.flavor: Keldon warriors take advantage of the cyclops's inability to focus on more than one thing at a time.

quotes.name: Ronin Houndmaster
quotes.flavor: Some samurai fell so far out of grace that only dogs would keep them company.

quotes.name: Blind Obedience
quotes.flavor: "By the time your knees have worn through your robe, you may have begun to learn your place."

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: On the volcanic continent of Akoum, bizarre vegetation clusters around gas vents, and jagged mountain peaks rise high into the air.

quotes.name: Poultice Sliver
quotes.flavor:
"Its broad claw suggests a chitinous shield, but in fact it conceals glands that secrete a remarkably swift healing agent."
—Rukarumel, field journal

quotes.name: Flow of Knowledge
quotes.flavor:
"Focus your mind. Do you hold a piece of the ocean or a thousand drops of rain?"
—Hurkyl

quotes.name: Lightning, Security Sergeant
quotes.flavor: "I had to be strong for Serah, so I thought I needed to forget my past. And I became Lightning."

quotes.name: Simic Guildgate
quotes.flavor: Enter and comprehend the perfection of orchestrated life.

quotes.name: Hyalopterous Lemure
quotes.flavor:
"The Lemures looked harmless, until they descended on my troops. Within moments, only bones remained."
—Lucilde Fiksdotter, Leader of the Order of the White Shield

quotes.name: Wilderness Reclamation
quotes.flavor:
"Walls crack. Buildings fall. Always the wilds return."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Dream Cache
quotes.flavor:
Dreams' riches are easily spent.
—Suq'Ata adage

quotes.name: Baral's Expertise
quotes.flavor: "Get out of my way."

quotes.name: Skyknight Legionnaire
quotes.flavor: Millennium Platform, once a monument to peace, was quickly seized by the skyknights for its strategic aerial location.

quotes.name: Copy Catchers
quotes.flavor:
"I honestly don't know if they're sabotaging our records or trying to help me sort."
—Kruno, Agency clerk

quotes.name: Mindlash Sliver
quotes.flavor: Though Dominaria's queenless slivers lack a single purpose, in some the instinct for self-sacrifice remains extremely strong.

quotes.name: Auger Spree
quotes.flavor:
"Finally, a weapon the Boros can't confiscate!"
—Juri, proprietor of the Juri Revue

quotes.name: Aether Snap
quotes.flavor:
"May you wake to find you were only ever a dream."
—Mephidross curse

quotes.name: Cloud of Darkness
quotes.flavor: "We are the Cloud of Darkness! Bringer of wrath and destroyer of light!"

quotes.name: Juntu Stakes
quotes.flavor:
"Those who can't survive are of no consequence."
—Tsabo Tavoc

quotes.name: Shire Terrace
quotes.set_name: The Lord of the Rings: Tales of Middle-earth
quotes.flavor: Everything looked fresh, and the new green of Spring was shimmering in the fields.

quotes.name: Yoshimaru, Ever Faithful
quotes.flavor: They would never again be parted.

quotes.name: Doomed Traveler
quotes.flavor: He vowed he would never rest until he reached his destination. He doesn't know how right he was.

quotes.name: This Town Ain't Big Enough
quotes.flavor: "All that fancy footwork, and you can't even dodge one silly little rope? Cryin' shame, that is."

quotes.name: Unseal the Necropolis
quotes.flavor: On Amonkhet, Phyrexia found a ready-made army of horrors waiting for a new master.

quotes.name: Abyssal Specter
quotes.flavor:
"Open the gates, and bid them enter."
—Lim-Dûl, the Necromancer

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: The Conflux crashed together far-flung continents, like ships colliding in a storm.

quotes.name: Kher Keep
quotes.flavor:
"I swear, for every one Prossh devours, three more pop out of a hole somewhere."
—Jaya Ballard

quotes.name: Play of the Game
quotes.flavor: The most sensational plays send everyone home breathless.

quotes.name: Blazing Salvo
quotes.flavor: Barbarians equate courage with the ability to endure pain.

quotes.name: Roller Coaster
quotes.flavor: Every rider leaves The Fluctuator happy—most because they're thrilled to still be alive.

quotes.name: Wild Mongrel
quotes.flavor: It teaches *you* to play dead.

quotes.name: Thrive
quotes.flavor: The most successful of Simic creations is cytoplasm, a living, symbiotic substance that feeds off genetic rhythms and strengthens its host in return.

quotes.name: Narset, Enlightened Exile
quotes.flavor: They called her unique insight a "gift." Then she saw the truth, and suddenly it was a "threat."

quotes.name: Rufus Shinra
quotes.flavor: "I'll control the world with fear. It takes too much to do it like my old man."

quotes.name: Compleated Huntmaster
quotes.flavor: The elves of Lorwyn sought perfection. The Etched Host supplied it.

quotes.name: Bury in Books
quotes.flavor: There are no weapons allowed in the Biblioplex, but a clever mage is never truly defenseless.

quotes.name: Carrion Howler
quotes.flavor: They chase tirelessly after the bone-carts that speed along the streets of the Plague Quarter.

quotes.name: Masked Admirers
quotes.flavor: "Beauty determines value, and we determine beauty."

quotes.name: Dual Shot
quotes.flavor: There is an eagerness among the Quiver of Kessig to prove they are the equal of the other cathar orders.

quotes.name: Scroll of Origins
quotes.flavor: The words from which language sprang, the knowledge from which thought was born, the story from which history was woven.

quotes.name: Terramorphic Expanse
quotes.flavor: Take two steps north into the unsettled future, south into the unquiet past, east into the present day, or west into the great unknown.

quotes.name: Martyr of Frost
quotes.set_name: Duel Decks Anthology: Jace vs. Chandra
quotes.flavor:
"Do not call the Balduvians barbaric. Their magic is as potent as it is primal."
—Zur the Enchanter

quotes.name: Go for the Throat
quotes.flavor: Having flesh is increasingly a liability on Mirrodin.

quotes.name: Felothar, Dawn of the Abzan
quotes.flavor: "Through perennation, we stand together, families—ancestor and kin─united as one clan! Abzan!"

quotes.name: Hypothesizzle
quotes.flavor:
"It's like blowing up an arcane library in a thermobaric explosion. But in a good way."
—Bori Andon, Izzet blastseeker

quotes.name: Boomerang
quotes.flavor: A lie always returns; be careful how you catch it.

quotes.name: Terminal Velocity
quotes.flavor: A victory was the best retirement gift the admiral could have asked for.

quotes.name: Rampant Growth
quotes.flavor: Rath forces plants from its surface as one presses whey from cheese.

quotes.name: Tandem Tactics
quotes.flavor: In times of infestation and war, Zendikar favors the blades that strike in unison.

quotes.name: Flame of Anor
quotes.flavor: There was a ringing clash and a stab of white fire, and the Balrog fell back.

quotes.name: Scheming Symmetry
quotes.flavor:
"One for you, one for me. What could be more fair?"
—Kethis, the Hidden Hand

quotes.name: Labyrinth of Skophos
quotes.flavor: For centuries, the minotaur polis of Skophos was unknown to humans. It remains unexplored.

quotes.name: Craterclaw Colossus
quotes.flavor: Some puppetbeasts are monstrous machines. Others, works of art. The best are both.

quotes.name: Overflowing Basin
quotes.flavor: Still to the ignorant eye, yet bursting with life. A million actions and reactions, unstoppable as the dawn.

quotes.name: Light Up the Stage
quotes.flavor: "Next—we need a volunteer from the audience! Who thinks they can stand very, very still?"

quotes.name: Centaur Courser
quotes.flavor:
"The centaurs are truly free. Never will they be tamed by temptation or controlled by fear. They live in total harmony, a feat not yet achieved by our kind."
—Ramal, sage of Westgate

quotes.name: Zealous Strike
quotes.flavor: "Cower, fiend. The night is yours no longer."

quotes.name: Farhaven Elf
quotes.flavor: "Verdant bloom does exist. It merely hides for its own safety."

quotes.name: Akroma, Angel of Wrath
quotes.flavor: Although she wore Nivea's kind face, her heart held nothing but vengeance.

quotes.name: Steel Overseer
quotes.flavor:
"The world is already run by all manner of machines. One day, they'll remind us of that fact."
—Sargis Haz, artificer

quotes.name: Wring Flesh
quotes.flavor:
"Don't blame me. You're the one walking around with skin."
—Zul Ashur, lich lord

quotes.name: Kjeldoran Royal Guard
quotes.flavor:
Honorable in battle, generous in death.
—Motto of the Kjeldoran Royal Guard

quotes.name: Vow of Wildness
quotes.flavor:
"Savagery is the birthright of every creature that draws breath—or wishes it could."
—Karador, Ghost Chieftain

quotes.name: Paradise Plume
quotes.flavor: A last wisp of paradise in a fallen world.

quotes.name: Amulet of Vigor
quotes.flavor:
"After years of study, I've learned an important lesson: the relics we watch may be watching us back."
—Anowon, the Ruin Sage

quotes.name: Rampaging Brontodon
quotes.flavor: Not even the tallest tree stands a chance against the underside of a dinosaur's foot.

quotes.name: Nostalgic Dreams
quotes.flavor: Seton dreams of life renewed.

quotes.name: Bloodsworn Steward
quotes.flavor: "My liege will lead and I will follow—to the battlefield, to the grave, and beyond."

quotes.name: Path to Exile
quotes.flavor:
"I am not your son. I am the Ghost."
—Jin Sakai

quotes.name: Timber Wolves
quotes.flavor: Though many think of Wolves as solitary predators, they are actually extremely social animals. During a hunt they often call to each other, which can be quite unsettling for their prey.

quotes.name: Untamed Wilds
quotes.flavor: No forest is so remote that the elves don't know its secrets.

quotes.name: Elvish Clancaller
quotes.flavor: No single root feeds the forest.

quotes.name: Goblin Snowman
quotes.flavor:
"Strength in numbers? Right."
—Ib Halfheart, Goblin Tactician

quotes.name: Weapons Trainer
quotes.flavor: "When I'm done training you, anything will be a deadly weapon."

quotes.name: Plains
quotes.flavor: You've traced the tensions in Ten-Towns to the dwindling reindeer populations ... but what has been hunting them?

quotes.name: Whip Sergeant
quotes.flavor: Keldon soldiers learn to move faster than the whip.

quotes.name: Ancient Cornucopia
quotes.flavor:
"I reckon that thing's trying to put me out of a job!"
—Bristly Bill, cactusfolk gardener

quotes.name: Flamewave Invoker
quotes.flavor: Inside even the humblest goblin lurks the potential for far greater things—and far worse.

quotes.name: Repulse
quotes.flavor: "You aren't invited."

quotes.name: Highway Robber
quotes.flavor: "Tonight, madam, it's your money *and* your life."

quotes.name: Erg Raiders
quotes.flavor: Their skills are extensive, and their appetite for battle just as vast.

quotes.name: River Bear
quotes.flavor: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

quotes.name: Frantic Search
quotes.flavor: It took the banning of temporal manipulation at Tolaria West to teach its students the value of time.

quotes.name: Tangled Colony
quotes.flavor: Clawing for scraps and driven mad by hunger, the individual rats became a writhing mass.

quotes.name: Ion Storm
quotes.flavor: When enough artifacts lie too long in the same place, their magical radiation weakens reality, opening rifts of unpredictable destructive power.

quotes.name: Furnace Punisher
quotes.flavor: She marks her favorite creations with a searing brand, leaving all others to be consumed by the furnace.

quotes.name: Armored Cancrix
quotes.flavor: Creatures displaced from time still turn up every year, stranded by the temporal disaster that once swept across Dominaria.

quotes.name: Labyrinth Minotaur
quotes.flavor:
"I doubt any labyrinth minotaurs still live—but then again, we minotaurs are stubborn beings."
—Onatah, Anaba Shaman

quotes.name: Selfless Police Captain
quotes.flavor:
"Peter always disappears when Spider-Man is around. How very odd."
—Captain George Stacy

quotes.name: Blight Pile
quotes.flavor:
"Keep your distance. It may be broken, but it's far from benign."
—Stenn

quotes.name: Defiant Strike
quotes.flavor:
「十二日間休みなく、ソマとは怪物の殻を攻撃した。十三日間のあさ、それは夜明けとともにひび割れた。」
—-英雄伝：寓話の書

quotes.name: Sprite Dragon
quotes.flavor: Size of a pixie, rage of a hellkite.

quotes.name: Dragonskull Summit
quotes.flavor:
"I . . . have . . . awakened! After countless centuries, I live again!"
—Fin Fang Foom

quotes.name: Mentor of the Meek
quotes.flavor: "In these halls there is no pass or fail. Your true test comes with the first full moon."

quotes.name: River Bear
quotes.flavor: The bears had been isolated on an island for hundreds of years, until the island sank and the bears didn't.

quotes.name: Yoked Ox
quotes.flavor: The courage of those who work the land is born of long days of labor in the hot summer sun and the cold winter wind. It is the courage of the earth itself.

quotes.name: Tectonic Instability
quotes.flavor:
"Think of the problems we'll face if you uproot entire continents," said Urza.
"I have," replied Teferi, "but the alternative is worse."

quotes.name: Public Execution
quotes.flavor: Though the executioner did not speak, the villagers got the message.

quotes.name: Wall of Wood
quotes.flavor: Everybody knows that to ward off trouble, you knock on wood. But usually it's better to make a wall out of the wood and let trouble do the knocking.

quotes.name: Fallen Angel
quotes.flavor: "Why do you weep for the dead? I rejoice, for they have died for me."

quotes.name: Gravel-Hide Goblin
quotes.flavor:
"No peace accord will save Ravnica. You don't build on rot. You burn it down and start again."
—Domri Rade

quotes.name: Ravages of War
quotes.flavor:
"Thorn bushes spring up wherever the army has passed. Lean years follow in the wake of a great war."
—Lao Tzu, Tao Te Ching, trans. Feng and English

quotes.name: Arc Runner
quotes.flavor: The storms of the wastelands form quickly and hit hard. Few have anything to do with rain.

quotes.name: Wild Might
quotes.flavor: The hunted can become the fiercest hunters.

quotes.name: Gate to Phyrexia
quotes.flavor: "The warm rain of grease on my face immediately made it clear I had entered Phyrexia." —Jarsyl, *Diary*

quotes.name: Condemn
quotes.flavor:
"No doubt the arbiters would put you away, after all the documents are signed. But I will have justice now."
—Alovnek, Boros guildmage

quotes.name: Flickerwisp
quotes.flavor: Its wings disturb more than air.

quotes.name: Marsh Hulk
quotes.flavor: Now vengeance is his sole purpose.

quotes.name: Rapid Hybridization
quotes.flavor:
"We've merged your life essence with that of several creatures at once. You're welcome."
—Speaker Trifon

quotes.name: Silence
quotes.flavor:
"Now, inhale through the nose and exhale through the mouth—without talking. Good. Keep going."
—Jeong Jeong, to Aang

quotes.name: Coastal Tower
quotes.flavor: The Capashen built the highest towers in Benalia to afford themselves the best view.

quotes.name: Volcanic Fallout
quotes.flavor:
"How can we outrun the sky?"
—Hadran, sunseeder of Naya

quotes.name: Simic Cluestone
quotes.flavor: Simic symbols are among the most intricate and fragile, yet few vandalize them for fear of the strange lifeforms that might be released.

quotes.name: Energy Flux
quotes.flavor:
"Nothing endures but change."
—Heraclitus

quotes.name: Winter, Tormented Loner
quotes.flavor: He had no one left to betray but himself.

quotes.name: Incremental Blight
quotes.flavor: Shadowmoor's main crops are rot, slime, and despair.

quotes.name: Mirari's Wake
quotes.flavor: Its passage through history is marked by warped desires and insatiable greed.

quotes.name: Nezumi Cutthroat
quotes.flavor:
"These nezumi, they disgust me. The things they will do for money no other thinking creature would consider. This, of course, makes them useful beyond words."
—Meloku the Clouded Mirror

quotes.name: Subterranean Tremors
quotes.flavor:
"There is one beast that makes even titans quail and quake in fear. We shall not name it here, for to name it is to call it."
—*A History of Ruinations*

quotes.name: Propaganda
quotes.flavor:
"It's subtler than that. Any stronger and people would question it. But contained in that rhythm, in layers of code, Vote Saxon. Believe in me. Whispering to the world."
—The Tenth Doctor

quotes.name: Gateway Shade
quotes.flavor: Tireless and merciless, shades are harnessed as spies by the Dimir.

quotes.name: Wall of Fire
quotes.flavor: The erupting flames work as both barrier and weapon.

quotes.name: Cinder Glade
quotes.flavor: Bury my shell on the lone prairie . . .

quotes.name: Eriette, the Beguiler
quotes.flavor: "Your dreams and mine will soon align."

quotes.name: Erratic Apparition
quotes.flavor:
"What's got you all bent out of shape?"
—Joseph, comedian, last words

quotes.name: New Perspectives
quotes.flavor: Understanding is a matter of perspective.

quotes.name: Icebind Pillar
quotes.flavor:
"Oh, Valki. I'm disappointed in you. How could the god of lies be so gullible?"
—Tibalt

quotes.name: Zombify
quotes.flavor:
"The first birth celebrates life. The second birth mocks it."
—Mystic elder

quotes.name: Kinsbaile Cavalier
quotes.flavor: Ambidexterity is common among kithkin. The thoughtweft links the minds of the left- and right-handed, giving each the knack of the other.

quotes.name: Lovisa Coldeyes
quotes.flavor: "I lead my horde to the northwest. I won't return until the ice wizards fall and their fiendish contraptions are crushed!"

quotes.name: Shanodin Dryads
quotes.flavor: Moving without sound, swift figures pass through branches and undergrowth completely unhindered. One with the trees around them, the Dryads of Shanodin Forest are seen only when they wish to be.

quotes.name: Sakura-Tribe Elder
quotes.flavor: He'd chosen a sunlit clearing with open skies and an ample brook. All that remained was to find a worthy sapling.

quotes.name: Mind Shatter
quotes.flavor: Pensamientos oscuros nacen y latigan en la mente, tratando de salir volando.

quotes.name: Stymied Hopes
quotes.flavor: When a god's will is against you, the day never ends well.

quotes.name: Slaughterhorn
quotes.flavor: The Orzhov clergy would never cross its path, but sending thrull couriers to do so is cheap and entertaining.

quotes.name: Thunderbreak Regent
quotes.flavor: Attracting a dragon's attention may be the last mistake you make.

quotes.name: Gift of the Gargantuan
quotes.flavor: To Alara's Wild Nacatl, the greatest blessing is to be spared by the behemoths.

quotes.name: Ant Queen
quotes.flavor:
"Kill the queen first, or we'll be fighting her drones forever. It is not in a queen's nature to have enough servants."
—Borzard, exterminator captain

quotes.name: Macabre Waltz
quotes.flavor:
"All dead move to the hollow rhythm of necromancy."
—Savra

quotes.name: Chilling Apparition
quotes.flavor: Mortal minds shrivel at its touch.

quotes.name: Mob Lookout
quotes.flavor:
"Hurry up before the bug gets here!"
—Hammerhead

quotes.name: Back for More
quotes.flavor: Ultimate Showdown Downgraded to Penultimate

quotes.name: Sliver Overlord
quotes.flavor: The end of evolution.

quotes.name: Chain Reaction
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"We train for the improbable, like lightning striking the same place twice, or striking everywhere at once."
—Nundari, Sea Gate militia captain

quotes.name: Banishing Light
quotes.flavor:
The Champion reached for a stone, and Heliod placed the sun into her hand.
—*The Theriad*

quotes.name: Nomad Outpost
quotes.flavor:
"The Mardu breathe life into what was lost under the dragonlords. If the Abzan are upset, it should be at themselves."
—Tersa Lightshatter

quotes.name: Plated Crusher
quotes.flavor:
"It might fight the Eldrazi, but don't mistake it for a companion, Gideon. It's not interested in your concept of strength through unity."
—Najiya, leader of the Tajuru

quotes.name: Forgotten Creation
quotes.set_name: Commander Legends: Battle for Baldur's Gate
quotes.flavor:
"My earliest work escapes me."
—Stitcher Geralf

quotes.name: Kazandu Mammoth // Kazandu Valley
quotes.flavor:
"It doesn't obey me. It cooperates with me."
—Triel, Kazandu tuskcaller
